mapper.sql: SELECT ca.ACCT_NO FROM CORP_USR u JOIN CORP_USR_GRP g ON g.ID = u.CORP_USR_GRP_ID AND g.CORP_ID = #{f.companyId} AND g.IS_DELETE = N'N' JOIN CORP_ACCT_GRP ag ON ag.ID = g.CORP_ACCT_GRP_ID AND ag.IS_DELETE = N'N' JOIN CORP_ACCT_GRP_DTL d ON d.CORP_ACCT_GRP_ID = ag.ID AND d.IS_INQ = N'Y' JOIN CORP_ACCT ca ON ca.ID = d.CORP_ACCT_NO WHERE u.USER_ID = #{f.userId}

SELECT N'TASK' AS SOURCE_CD, t.ID AS TASK_ID, t.REF_NO AS REF_NO, t.TRX_REF_NO AS TRX_REF_NO, t.MENU_CD AS MENU_CD, t.SRVC_CD AS SRVC_CD, t.STATUS AS RAW_STATUS, CASE t.STATUS WHEN N'EXECUTED' THEN N'BERHASIL' WHEN N'FAILED' THEN N'GAGAL' WHEN N'REJECTED' THEN N'GAGAL' ELSE N'DIPROSES' END AS STATUS_GROUP, t.TRX_AMT AS TRX_AMT, t.TRX_CCY_CD AS TRX_CCY_CD, t.REM_ACCT_NO AS REM_ACCT_NO, t.BEN_ACCT_NO AS BEN_ACCT_NO, t.BEN_ACCT_NM AS BEN_ACCT_NM, t.REMARK1 AS REMARK1, t.INSTRUCTION_MODE AS INSTRUCTION_MODE, t.INSTRUCTION_DT AS INSTRUCTION_DT, t.CREATED_DT AS CREATED_DT, t.EXECUTED_DT AS EXECUTED_DT, t.CORE_JOURNAL AS JOURNAL_NO, t.MAKER_USER_NAME AS MAKER_USER_NAME, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR2(40)) AS ORDER_PARTY_REF_NO, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR2(40)) AS COUNTER_PARTY_REF_NO FROM TRX_TASK t WHERE t.CORP_ID = #{f.companyId} UNION ALL SELECT N'LEGACY', CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR2(40)), f.REF_NO, f.TRX_REF_NO, f.MNU_CD, f.SRVC_CD, CASE WHEN f.IS_PROCESSED = N'Y' THEN N'EXECUTED' ELSE N'PENDING' END, CASE WHEN f.IS_PROCESSED = N'Y' THEN N'BERHASIL' ELSE N'DIPROSES' END, f.TRX_AMT, f.TRX_CCY_CD, f.REM_ACCT_NO, f.BEN_ACCT_NO, f.BEN_ACCT_NM, f.REMARK1, f.INSTRUCTION_MODE, f.INSTRUCTION_DT, f.CREATED_DT, CASE WHEN f.IS_PROCESSED = N'Y' THEN f.CREATED_DT END, TO_NCHAR(f.JOURNAL_NO), mk.USER_ID, f.ORDER_PARTY_REF_NO, f.COUNTER_PARTY_REF_NO FROM BASE_FT f LEFT JOIN CORP_USR mk ON mk.ID = f.CREATED_BY WHERE f.REM_ACCT_NO IN (SELECT ca2.ACCT_NO FROM CORP_ACCT ca2 WHERE ca2.CORP_ID = #{f.companyId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRX_TASK x WHERE x.CORP_ID = #{f.companyId} AND x.REF_NO = f.REF_NO)

SELECT r.SOURCE_CD AS "source", r.TASK_ID AS "taskId", r.REF_NO AS "refNo", r.TRX_REF_NO AS "trxRefNo", r.MENU_CD AS "menuCd", r.SRVC_CD AS "srvcCd", s.NM AS "srvcNm", r.RAW_STATUS AS "rawStatus", r.STATUS_GROUP AS "statusGroup", r.TRX_AMT AS "trxAmt", r.TRX_CCY_CD AS "trxCcyCd", r.REM_ACCT_NO AS "remAcctNo", a.ACCT_NM AS "remAcctNm", a.CCY_CD AS "remAcctCcy", r.BEN_ACCT_NO AS "benAcctNo", r.BEN_ACCT_NM AS "benAcctNm", r.REMARK1 AS "remark1", r.INSTRUCTION_MODE AS "instructionMode", r.INSTRUCTION_DT AS "instructionDt", r.CREATED_DT AS "createdDt", r.EXECUTED_DT AS "executedDt", r.JOURNAL_NO AS "journalNo", r.MAKER_USER_NAME AS "makerUserName", r.ORDER_PARTY_REF_NO AS "orderPartyRefNo", r.COUNTER_PARTY_REF_NO AS "counterPartyRefNo" FROM () r LEFT JOIN ACCT a ON a.ACCT_NO = r.REM_ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN COM_ST_SRVC s ON s.CD = r.SRVC_CD
mapper.select: ORDER BY r.CREATED_DT DESC, r.REF_NO DESC OFFSET #{f.offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{f.size} ROWS ONLY
